startupScan_Help: Glob masks, relative to workbench/plugins, probed for plugin manifests (two levels deep by default).
skipScan_Help: Case-insensitive masks; a manifest whose relative path or any path segment matches is never scanned.
pluginsFound_Help: Auto-maintained: every discovered plugin is recorded here. Set enabled: false (or scan: disabled) to keep one unloaded; scan says when to rescan its config.
